title: Stewardship Touchpoint: Executive Snapshot & Quarterly Recap Template
content:
Purpose: A compact, repeatable one-page executive snapshot and a two-variant customer-facing quarterly recap email library. Use this doc to prepare sponsor-level updates that are scannable, factual, and linked to action-oriented asks. Keep the executive snapshot to one page; attach a 2–3 page appendix for deeper metrics or log extracts.

Audience: Executive sponsor, VP/Head of AI/Product, CSM, Solutions Architect.

How to use:
- Fill in the header fields (period, customer, CSM, renewal window).
- Populate metrics with the most recent 30/90 day data.
- Call out any active risks and the mitigation owner.
- Choose the short or long email variant based on sponsor preference.
- Upload appendix (logs, cost breakdown, performance charts) and link in the email.

1) One-Page Executive Snapshot (Replace bracketed values)
- Header: Quarter: [Q# YYYY] | Customer: [Org name] | Sponsor: [Name, title] | CSM: [Name] | Renewal window: [MM/YYYY] | Health: [Green/Yellow/Red]
- TL;DR (1 sentence): [High-level outcome and ask: e.g., "Performance is stable with 12% cost savings from batching; request approval for a pilot of dedicated capacity to reduce 95th-pct latency."]
- Key metrics (30d / 90d where useful):
  - Avg latency (p95): [ms]
  - Throughput: [requests / min] or [tokens / min]
  - Error rate (5xx+timeout): [percent]
  - Monthly run-rate spend vs. committed: [$ / % of budget]
  - Feature usage highlights: [Embeddings: x calls/day; Chat: x sessions/day]
- Business impact / customer outcome (3 bullets):
  - [Customer-specific outcome #1 — e.g., "Search relevance improved by NPS +5; small conversion uplift measured in A/B test".]
  - [Outcome #2]
  - [Outcome #3]
- Wins (recent):
  1. [Win A — e.g., "Rolled out model quantization, reduced cost per token by 18%."]
  2. [Win B — e.g., "Resolved a cross-region routing issue that improved failover time from 90s to 8s."]
- Current risks / open blockers (include owner & ETA):
  1. [Risk: e.g., "Burst capacity constraints during batch jobs"] Owner: [Name] ETA: [date] Mitigation: [short plan]
  2. [Risk 2 — include Jira ticket if available: JIRA-#####]
- Roadmap alignment & asks (explicit, timeboxed):
  - Short ask (decision needed in 2 weeks): [e.g., "Approve dedic capacity pilot: commit $X/mo for 3 months"]
  - Medium ask: [e.g., "Agree to co-run a latency regression test during next sprint"]
- Renewal snapshot & recommendation:
  - Renewal date: [MM/DD/YYYY]
  - Current ARR / committed spend: [$]
  - Renewal risk: [Low/Medium/High] — reason: [text]
  - Recommended contract posture: [e.g., "Upsell to dedicated, 12-month commitment; include SLA"]
- Next steps & owners (3 items max):
  1. [Owner] Schedule technical deep-dive (by [date])
  2. [Owner] Share cost forecast & pro forma (by [date])
  3. [Owner] Draft renewal terms (by [date])
- Attachments (appendix):
  - Performance charts: p50/p95 latency by endpoint, error breakdown by status code, throughput heatmap
  - Billing snapshot: month-to-date and 90-day trend, cost-per-1000-tokens
  - Open technical tickets: list of Jira IDs

2) Customer-facing Quarterly Recap — Email Variants
Variant A — Short (executive sponsor preferred quick read)
Subject lines (pick one):
  - "[Org] Q[ ] Recap: performance, cost, and next steps"
  - "Quarterly update — [Org] & Redwood: outcomes and asks"
Email body (short):
  Hi [Sponsor name],

  Quick recap for [Q# YYYY]:
  - TL;DR: [one-sentence summary of health/outcome]
  - Key metrics: p95 latency [ms] | Error rate [x%] | Cost trend [±% vs prior quarter]
  - Top 2 wins: [brief bullets]
  - Current ask: [e.g., "Approve a 3-month Dedicated pilot to stabilize 95th-pct latency"]

  I’ve attached a 1-page snapshot and a short appendix with charts. Can we schedule 20 minutes next week to align on the ask? Please share times that work.

  Thanks,
  [CSM name]

Variant B — Detailed (for broader stakeholder distribution)
Subject lines (pick one):
  - "[Org] Q[ ] Customer Recap & Roadmap Alignment"
  - "Q[ ] Results + next steps: performance, savings, and renewal"
Email body (long):
  Hi [Sponsor name] and team,

  Attached is our Q[ ] recap. Highlights below and asks at the end.

  Highlights:
  - Business impact: [2–3 bullets linking product outcomes to business metrics — e.g., "Search engagement +12% month over month; average session length +8%."]
  - Stability & performance: p95 latency [ms], availability [99.9x%], error rate [x%]
  - Cost & efficiency: cost per 1k tokens [current]; net savings from batching/quantization [x%]
  - Feature adoption: [e.g., "Embeddings pipeline currently used by Product team for personalization; 1.2M calls this quarter"]

  Open items & risks:
  - [Ticket/Jira] Brief description and owner
  - [Risk] Consequence and mitigation plan

  Asks / decisions needed:
  1. Approve Dedicated pilot ($X/mo) — decision by [date] — owner: [Sponsor]
  2. Confirm next integration milestone for feature X — owner: [Product stakeholder]

  Renewal snapshot:
  - Renewal date: [MM/YYYY]
  - Recommended approach: [e.g., "12-month commit with usage buffer"]

  Proposed next steps:
  - 30-min alignment call (tech + exec) — proposed slots: [dates/times]
  - Delivery of cost model and pro forma by [date] — owner: [CSM]

  Thanks for the partnership — looking forward to aligning on the next phase.

  Best,
  [CSM name]

3) Renewal tracker (one-line CSV-style examples you can paste into a sheet)
- Column header suggestion: Org, Renewal date, ARR, Contract type, Renewal risk, Primary sponsor, CSM, Next step, Next step due, Owner, Notes
- Example rows (paste directly into a sheet):
  - "Acme Corp,2026-07-15,$120,000,Usage + Commit,Medium,Elena Park,Marcus Patel,Schedule renewal scoping call,2026-04-10,Marcus,Customer evaluating Dedicated"
  - "Nimbus Labs,2026-10-01,$850,000,Dedicated annual,Low,CTO: Rajesh Singh,Avery Chen,Share SLA template,2026-05-01,Avery,Interested in multi-region"

4) Suggested internal prep checklist (CSM + Solutions)
- Update one-page snapshot in shared drive (this file)
- Attach performance charts and billing snapshot
- Run a quick smoke test of critical endpoints and paste results in appendix
- Confirm stakeholder list & preferred meeting cadence with sponsor
- Draft proposed renewal language and pricing options for review by sales/legal

5) Meeting agenda template (20–30 minutes)
- 1 min: Thank you / purpose of meeting
- 3 min: TL;DR and one-page snapshot walk-through
- 8–10 min: Technical highlights & risk mitigations (SAs present as needed)
- 5 min: Discuss asks and alignment (approval, pilot, budget)
- 3 min: Confirm next steps and owners

6) Tone and language guidance
- Be concise and data-first. Executives prefer 1–2 bullets per topic.
- Call out decisions and timeboxes clearly.
- Use absolute numbers for impact (ARR, % cost change, ms latency).
- Avoid technical deep dives in the main body — move to appendix.

7) Example: Filled snapshot (fictional)
- Header: Q1 2026 | Customer: Nimbus Labs | Sponsor: Rajesh Singh, CTO | CSM: Avery Chen | Renewal: 2026-10-01 | Health: Green
- TL;DR: "Performance stable; 15% cost savings from batching; propose a 3-month dedicated pilot to reduce p95 latency and guarantee SLA for peak trading windows."
- Key metrics: p95: 280ms | Throughput: 48k req/day | Error rate: 0.2% | Spend vs budget: $210k / 92%
- Wins: 1) Quantization saved 15% cost; 2) API contract extension rolled out for embeddings
- Risks: 1) Regional failover test pending (Owner: SRE, ETA: 2026-03-15)
- Ask: Approve Dedicated pilot (Owner: Rajesh) decision by 2026-03-22

8) Quick boilerplate signatures
- Short: "Thanks,
  Avery Chen
  Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
  avery.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-01xx"
- Long (includes links): "Best,
  Avery Chen | CSM — Redwood Inference
  avery.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-01xx
  Project folder: [link] | Appendix: [link] | Jira: JIRA-1245"

9) Notes on privacy & attachments
- Redact any PII from appended logs before sharing externally.
- For customers with private deployments, do not include internal infra IPs in screenshots.

10) Version control & follow-up
- Save the completed snapshot in the customer folder under: shared_drives/customer-success/[Org]/qbr/
- Name the file: [Org]-qbr-snapshot-Q[ ]-[YYYY].docx
- After the meeting, send a 1-paragraph follow-up email with action items and owners within 24 hours.

End of template.

Draft notes / TODOs (CSM checklist):
- [ ] Pull last 90-day costs from Billing report
- [ ] Run p95 latency query for relevant endpoints (SRE assistance: ticket JIRA-2234)
- [ ] Create appendix charts and attach to email
- [ ] Confirm sponsor availability and preferred email length

Editors: Marcus Patel (review technical accuracy), Sofia Morales (tone & execs), Ellen Wu (renewal language).

Document history: Created 2025-11-02 by Avery Chen. Significant edits 2026-01-12 (metrics section reworded), 2026-02-20 (added renewal tracker examples), 2026-03-01 (final review).
